purpose: Teach: フィート/エアー/クロック/エリザベス/ミスター/ハワード/ルビー/パット

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、米国フィート単位の換算苦手だったろ
lines.en: You were never great at converting US feet, were you, Riku?
lines.style: Playful jab masked as innocence. Quick, knowing smirk. The tone of someone about to spring a trap, eyes glinting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、エアー、つまりエアジョーダン履いてたな、桜
lines.en: Yeah? Well, weren't you wearing Air Jordans the other day, Sakura?
lines.style: Caught red-handed but deflecting smoothly. Light, almost teasing turn-back. Leaning into the counter-attack with a half-smile.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、古いクロックの修理してたな
lines.en: Oh, so you remember me fixing that old clock?
lines.style: Arch, drawing out the observation. Slow, deliberate. The satisfaction of catching someone paying attention when they pretend not to.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会の授業でエリザベス女王習ったろ、桜
lines.en: And you were paying attention in social studies when we covered Queen Elizabeth, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turning the tables back. Matter-of-fact but with a glint. Not accusatory, just — you were there, you know what I'm talking about.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ミスター・チルドレンのファンだったな
lines.en: You're a Mr. Children fan, Riku — don't try to hide that.
lines.style: Soft triumph in the observation. Knowing, affectionate teasing. The kind of thing said with a smile that says 'I know all your secrets.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語の教科書でハワードの物語読んでたろ、桜
lines.en: And you read that Howard story in English class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle, genuine curiosity breaking through. Quieter this time — less trap-setting, more actual interest. The real question underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宝石のルビーの色当てクイズしてたな
lines.en: I saw you doing that ruby color quiz game the other day, Riku.
lines.style: Smug but warm. Slow delivery on the observation, letting it land. The satisfaction of noticing something someone thought was private.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゴルフ部でパット練習頑張ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were actually putting in real work at golf club practice, Sakura — saw you grinding.
lines.style: Sincere recognition softened by cool distance. Genuine praise delivered quietly, like it costs something to say it out loud. Slight nod of respect.
